name: io.github.First-CH/tools-mcp
description: MCP tools: WCAG contrast, JP char/X-weight count, WebP convert, JSON-LD, llms.txt, encoding/line-ending convert, Marp Markdown→slides render.

environmentVariables.name: FIRSTCH_TOOLS_USAGE_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to a local JSONL file for opt-in usage logging. No logging when unset.

environmentVariables.name: MARP_CHROME_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to a Chrome/Chromium executable used by marp_render for PDF output. Auto-detected on common paths when unset; PDF is skipped (HTML still returned) if none is found.
